ayet.metin_ar: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
ayet.metin_en: When My servants ask you about Me, tell them I am truly near. I answer the prayer of whoever calls on Me.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Allah's nearness to His servant and His acceptance of supplication

ayet.metin_ar: وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ
ayet.metin_en: Yet all they were commanded was to worship Allah, devoting their faith sincerely to Him alone.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Sincerity and purity of intention in deeds

ayet.metin_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
ayet.metin_en: Indeed, Allah is with those who are patient.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Allah's companionship with those who are patient

ayet.metin_ar: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
ayet.metin_en: If you are grateful, I will surely give you even more.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The divine promise that gratitude increases blessings

ayet.metin_ar: مَا أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَا
ayet.metin_en: No misfortune strikes the earth or yourselves without it being written in a Book before We bring it into being.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Destiny's connection to divine decree

ozel_gun.isim: Last Day of Sha'ban / Eve of Ramadan
ozel_gun.mesaj: One day before Ramadan. A time for intention and preparation.

ayet.metin_ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ
ayet.metin_en: O you who believe, fasting has been prescribed for you, just as it was prescribed for those before you.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The obligatory nature of Ramadan fasting — preparation on the eve

29.ibadet_hatirlatma: Inviting someone to iftar, giving charity, and renewing intention are beautiful ways to prepare for Ramadan tomorrow.

ozel_gun.mesaj: The first day of the month of mercy. Every blessed journey begins with a sincere intention.

ayet.metin_ar: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ
ayet.metin_en: Ramadan is the month in which the Qur'an was sent down as guidance for people.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Ramadan's fundamental connection to the Qur'an and its definition

1.ibadet_hatirlatma: Tarawih and Tahajjud prayer on the first night of Ramadan is Sunnah.

ozel_gun.mesaj: First steps in patience and gratitude.

ayet.metin_ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ
ayet.metin_en: O you who believe, seek help through patience and prayer.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Allah's companionship with those who are patient

2.ibadet_hatirlatma: Eating suhur is Sunnah; blessing lies in suhur.

ozel_gun.mesaj: The seal of the first three days.

ayet.metin_ar: التَّائِبُونَ الْعَابِدُونَ الْحَامِدُونَ السَّائِحُونَ
ayet.metin_en: The believers are those who turn back to Allah, worship Him, praise Him and fast.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The qualities of the fasting servant of Allah

3.ibadet_hatirlatma: The first days of Ramadan fasting are the hardest; patience and habit grow together.

ozel_gun.mesaj: The days of mercy continue.

ayet.metin_ar: وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
ayet.metin_en: My mercy embraces all things.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The boundlessness of Allah's mercy — during the days of mercy

4.ibadet_hatirlatma: Increase Qur'an recitation; do not neglect Tarawih and Tahajjud.

ozel_gun.mesaj: The gates of Allah's mercy stand open.

ayet.metin_ar: كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ
ayet.metin_en: Your Lord has made mercy a duty upon Himself.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Allah having written mercy upon Himself

5.ibadet_hatirlatma: Inviting a neighbour or someone in need to your iftar today is greatly rewarded.

ozel_gun.mesaj: We go deeper into mercy.

ayet.metin_ar: قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayet.metin_en: Say: Can those who know and those who do not know ever be equal?
ayet.secim_gerekce: Turning to the Qur'an and knowledge during Ramadan

6.ibadet_hatirlatma: Reading at least one hizb of the Qur'an daily in Ramadan is recommended.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Last day of the mercy week.

ayet.metin_ar: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
ayet.metin_en: Remember Me, and I will remember you. Be grateful to Me, and never be ungrateful.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Reciprocity in remembrance — the importance of dhikr in Ramadan

7.ibadet_hatirlatma: Make tasbih, istighfar and salawat part of your daily litany.

ozel_gun.isim: Seal of the Days of Mercy (8)
ozel_gun.mesaj: The days of mercy close; the days of forgiveness draw near.

ayet.metin_ar: وَسَارِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ
ayet.metin_en: Hurry toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Paradise as vast as the heavens and the earth.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Preparation for the transition from days of mercy to days of forgiveness

8.ibadet_hatirlatma: Reflect on how you used the days of mercy; enter the days of forgiveness with sincere intention.

ozel_gun.isim: Seal of the Days of Mercy (9)
ozel_gun.mesaj: Toward the second ten days.

ayet.metin_ar: سَابِقُوا إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ
ayet.metin_en: Race one another toward forgiveness from your Lord and toward Paradise.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The command to race towards forgiveness

9.ibadet_hatirlatma: Repent from your sins and prepare for the days of forgiveness.

ozel_gun.isim: Seal of the Days of Mercy (10)
ozel_gun.mesaj: Last day of the first ten.

ayet.metin_ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
ayet.metin_en: The believers have truly succeeded.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The glad tidings of success and salvation

10.ibadet_hatirlatma: A good time for charity, plentiful istighfar, and entering the forgiveness days with a pure heart.

ozel_gun.mesaj: First day of the second ten. The door of forgiveness has opened.

ayet.metin_ar: وَأَنِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ
ayet.metin_en: Ask your Lord for forgiveness, then turn back to Him.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Istighfar and repentance commanded together

11.ibadet_hatirlatma: Days of forgiveness. Increase istighfar: 'Astaghfirullah wa atubu ilayh.'

ozel_gun.mesaj: Days of cleansing from sin.

ayet.metin_ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ سُوءًا أَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ يَجِدِ اللَّهَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
ayet.metin_en: Whoever does wrong or wrongs themselves, and then asks Allah for forgiveness, will find Allah Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The door of repentance remains open after sin

12.ibadet_hatirlatma: Do not put off repentance these days; Allah's forgiveness is boundless.

ozel_gun.mesaj: These days also fall among the white days (13th–15th) of the Hijri month.

ayet.metin_ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَأُولَٰئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ
ayet.metin_en: Except those who repent, believe and do good deeds: for them Allah will turn their bad deeds into good ones.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Repentance transforming sins into good deeds

13.ibadet_hatirlatma: If you did wrong, do not despair — the door of repentance is open to you.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Remember the rights of others too.

ayet.metin_ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَعْفُو عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ
ayet.metin_en: He is the One who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons bad deeds.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Allah being the One who accepts repentance and pardons

14.ibadet_hatirlatma: Make peace with anyone you are estranged from; Allah's forgiveness comes before people's forgiveness.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Mid-Ramadan self-reckoning.

ayet.metin_ar: لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا
ayet.metin_en: Do not lose hope in Allah's mercy. Allah truly forgives all sins.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Allah's infinite forgiveness and the door of hope always open

15.ibadet_hatirlatma: You have reached halfway through Ramadan. Keep going; do not lose sight of your goal.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Sins are pardoned; hearts are illumined.

ayet.metin_ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا
ayet.metin_en: O you who believe, turn to Allah in sincere repentance.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Tawbah Nasuh — sincere repentance with no return to sin

16.ibadet_hatirlatma: Nasuh repentance: sincere regret and resolve not to return to the sin.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Days of pardon and reconciliation.

ayet.metin_ar: وَالْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ بِالْأَسْحَارِ
ayet.metin_en: They are those who ask Allah for forgiveness in the hours before dawn.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The virtue of seeking forgiveness in the pre-dawn hours

17.ibadet_hatirlatma: Do not sleep through the last third of the night; deepen Ramadan with istighfar and Tahajjud.

ozel_gun.mesaj: The second dozen ends; the final ten approach.

ayet.metin_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
ayet.metin_en: Allah loves those who keep turning back to Him, and He loves those who keep themselves pure.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The one who repents becoming beloved to Allah

18.ibadet_hatirlatma: Give more charity today. The Prophet ﷺ said charity extinguishes anger.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Preparing for the final ten.

ayet.metin_ar: وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِ
ayet.metin_en: He will give you a light by which you can walk.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The guiding light of faith — entering the final ten days

19.ibadet_hatirlatma: Mend broken hearts; that is the spiritual preparation for the final ten.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Tomorrow the final ten begin.

ayet.metin_ar: يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
ayet.metin_en: O soul at peace!
ayet.secim_gerekce: Entering the final ten days with a heart at peace

20.ibadet_hatirlatma: Take stock of twenty days; tomorrow the final ten begin.

ozel_gun.isim: Beginning of the Last Ten — Night 21
ozel_gun.mesaj: In the last ten nights the Prophet ﷺ would tighten his belt, spend the night in worship, and wake his family.

ayet.metin_ar: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ
ayet.metin_en: We sent it (the Qur'an) down on the Night of Decree.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The first verse of Surah Al-Qadr — at the start of the final ten

21.ibadet_hatirlatma: The last ten have begun; increase i'tikaf, Tahajjud and Qur'an recitation.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Those seeking Laylat al-Qadr sleep less.

ayet.metin_ar: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
ayet.metin_en: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
ayet.secim_gerekce: A reminder of the night worth more than a thousand months

22.ibadet_hatirlatma: From this night onward, each odd night is a candidate for Laylat al-Qadr; be ready.

ozel_gun.mesaj: One of the odd nights of the last ten; tonight could be Laylat al-Qadr.

ayet.metin_ar: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
ayet.metin_en: On that night the angels and the Spirit (Gabriel) descend, by their Lord's permission, with every decree.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The Night of Qadr filled with angels descending

23.ibadet_hatirlatma: Tonight the du'a 'Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni' is often recited.

ozel_gun.mesaj: The search for Laylat al-Qadr continues.

ayet.metin_ar: سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ
ayet.metin_en: That night is peace until the break of dawn.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The Night of Qadr filled with peace until the break of dawn

24.ibadet_hatirlatma: Keep worshiping until the pre-dawn; do not tire — morning is near.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Every night Allah calls His servants in the last third.

ayet.metin_ar: وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَالصَّادِقِينَ وَالْقَانِتِينَ وَالْمُنفِقِينَ وَالْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ بِالْأَسْحَارِ
ayet.metin_en: They are the patient, the truthful, the devoted, those who give for Allah's sake, and those who ask for forgiveness in the hours before dawn.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The virtue of seeking forgiveness in the pre-dawn hours

25.ibadet_hatirlatma: Rise for the last third; Allah descends then to respond to those who ask.

ozel_gun.isim: One Step to Laylat al-Qadr — Night 26
ozel_gun.mesaj: Laylat al-Qadr draws near; renew your intention and ready yourself for worship.

ayet.metin_ar: فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا لِي وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا بِي لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ
ayet.metin_en: So let them respond to Me and believe in Me, so that they may be rightly guided.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Allah's nearness to His servant and His acceptance of supplication

26.ibadet_hatirlatma: From tonight strengthen your intention; increase Tahajjud, istighfar and charity.

ozel_gun.mesaj: The Night of Power, better than a thousand months. Recite this supplication often: 'Allahumma innaka afuwwun tuhibbul afwa fa'fu anni.'

ayet.metin_ar: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
ayet.metin_en: On that night every matter of wisdom is made clear and decided.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The annual divine decree being written on the Night of Qadr

27.ibadet_hatirlatma: Spend the entire night in worship. The Fajr prayer is the seal of Qadr.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Entering the last days of Ramadan — a time of farewell and glad tidings.

ayet.metin_ar: وَلِتُكْمِلُوا الْعِدَّةَ وَلِتُكَبِّرُوا اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَاكُمْ
ayet.metin_en: This is so that you complete the number of days and glorify Allah for having guided you.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Ramadan's fundamental connection to the Qur'an and its definition

28.ibadet_hatirlatma: Prepare your Zakat al-Fitr from today.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Farewell to Ramadan — a day of both sorrow and joy.

ayet.metin_ar: قُلْ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا
ayet.metin_en: Say: Let them rejoice in Allah's grace and mercy.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Joy at the completion of Ramadan — Allah's bounty and mercy

29.ibadet_hatirlatma: Give Zakat al-Fitr before the Eid prayer; spend Eid eve in worship.

ayet.metin_ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
ayet.metin_en: I created jinn and humans only so that they would worship Me.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Worship as the purpose of creation

ozel_gun.mesaj: Allahu Akbar! The day of reward for Ramadan. Eid prayer, takbir and gratitude.

ayet.metin_ar: وَلِتُكَبِّرُوا اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَاكُمْ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
ayet.metin_en: Glorify Allah for having guided you, so that you may be grateful.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Ramadan's fundamental connection to the Qur'an and its definition

1.ibadet_hatirlatma: Eid prayer is Sunnah. Go to the prayer ground reciting the Takbir.

ozel_gun.mesaj: A day to visit family and relatives.

ayet.metin_ar: يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ
ayet.metin_en: My dear son, keep up the prayer, encourage what is good and forbid what is wrong.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Eid united with family and social responsibility

2.ibadet_hatirlatma: Visit elders today and give gifts to children.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Last day of Eid. What have you gained?

ayet.metin_ar: وَالْعَصْرِ ۝ إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَفِي خُسْرٍ ۝ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا
ayet.metin_en: By time, humankind is surely at a loss, except those who believe.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Eid ends, but the good character gained must continue

3.ibadet_hatirlatma: Keep the habits you built in Ramadan throughout the year.

ayet.metin_ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
ayet.metin_en: Truly, with every hardship comes ease.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The promise that every difficulty is accompanied by ease

ayet.metin_ar: ادْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ
ayet.metin_en: Call people to the way of your Lord with wisdom and kind, beautiful advice.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Da'wah must be grounded in wisdom and good counsel

ozel_gun.mesaj: Fasting six days of Shawwal earns the reward of fasting the whole year.

ayet.metin_ar: مَن جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا
ayet.metin_en: Whoever comes with a good deed will receive ten times as much.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Ten-fold reward for good deeds — the calculation of Shawwal fasting

6.ibadet_hatirlatma: Six days of Shawwal: Ramadan (30×10=300) + Shawwal (6×10=60) = 360, like fasting a full year.

ayet.metin_ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
ayet.metin_en: I created jinn and humans only so that they would worship Me.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Worship as the purpose of creation

ayet.metin_ar: مَّثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ
ayet.metin_en: Those who spend their wealth for the sake of Allah are like a single seed that grows seven ears of grain.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The manifold reward of charity

ayet.metin_ar: وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِحَبْلِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُوا
ayet.metin_en: Hold on firmly to the rope of Allah, all of you together, and do not split apart.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The unity and solidarity of Muslims

ayet.metin_ar: وَلَٰكِنَّ الْبِرَّ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ
ayet.metin_en: Truly good is the one who believes in Allah and the Last Day.
ayet.secim_gerekce: A comprehensive definition of true faith

ayet.metin_ar: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
ayet.metin_en: If you are grateful, I will surely give you even more.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The divine promise that gratitude increases blessings

ayet.metin_ar: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّا أُخْفِيَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ
ayet.metin_en: No one knows what joy and delight has been kept hidden for them as a reward for what they used to do.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The unknown beauties of Paradise that await the righteous

8.ibadet_hatirlatma: If you are not performing Hajj, recite much takbir, tahlil and istighfar on these days.

ozel_gun.mesaj: The pinnacle of Hajj and the most virtuous day of the year. Fasting expiates the sins of the past and coming year.

ayet.metin_ar: الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِي
ayet.metin_en: Today I have perfected your religion for you and completed My blessing upon you.
ayet.secim_gerekce: This verse was revealed on the Day of Arafah at Mount Arafat

9.ibadet_hatirlatma: Fasting today expiates the sins of the past and coming year (for those not on Hajj).

ozel_gun.mesaj: The memory of Prophet Ibrahim's sacrifice. The sacrifice is made, the Eid prayer is performed.

ayet.metin_ar: لَن يَنَالَ اللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَاؤُهَا وَلَٰكِن يَنَالُهُ التَّقْوَىٰ مِنكُمْ
ayet.metin_en: Neither their meat nor their blood reaches Allah; what reaches Him is your devotion and mindfulness of Him.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The essence of the sacrifice is God-consciousness (taqwa)

10.ibadet_hatirlatma: Eid al-Adha prayer is performed and the sacrifice is made. Takbir is recited.

ozel_gun.mesaj: The tashriq days begin — takbir, dhikr and Eid joy.

ayet.metin_ar: وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ فِي أَيَّامٍ مَّعْدُودَاتٍ
ayet.metin_en: Remember Allah during the appointed days.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The command to remember Allah during the Tashriq days

11.ibadet_hatirlatma: Tashriq takbirs: 'Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaha illallah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi'l-hamd.'

ozel_gun.mesaj: Continuation of the tashriq days.

ayet.metin_ar: إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ
ayet.metin_en: We have given you al-Kawthar (abundant good).
ayet.secim_gerekce: The abundance of Allah's blessings — gratitude on Eid days

12.ibadet_hatirlatma: Share the sacrificial meat: one third family, one third relatives, one third those in need.

ozel_gun.mesaj: Last day of the tashriq days.

ayet.metin_ar: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَانْحَرْ
ayet.metin_en: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice.
ayet.secim_gerekce: Prayer and sacrifice commanded together

13.ibadet_hatirlatma: The tashriq takbirs end with the Dhuhr prayer.

ayet.metin_ar: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
ayet.metin_en: If you are grateful, I will surely give you even more.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The divine promise that gratitude increases blessings

14.ibadet_hatirlatma: Today (Dhu al-Hijjah 14) is one of the White Days (Ayyam al-Bid). The Prophet ﷺ used to fast on the 13th, 14th and 15th of every month.

ayet.metin_ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
ayet.metin_en: Allah: there is no god but Him. He is the Ever-Living, the One who sustains and governs all that exists.
ayet.secim_gerekce: The essence of monotheism — Allah's oneness and eternal existence

ayet.metin_en: The most honoured of you in Allah's sight is the one who is most mindful of Him.
ayet.secim_gerekce: True honor is tied to God-consciousness

ayet.metin_en: Hold on firmly to the rope of Allah, all of you together, and do not split apart.

ayet.metin_en: Those who spend their wealth for the sake of Allah are like a single seed that grows seven ears of grain.

ayet.secim_gerekce: Justice upheld solely for the sake of Allah
